**Players present:** Kaitlyn (Kto), Fox (Fiorn), Sev (Yinu), Lily (Loric T.), Piper (Nalith)

- Party took Torval's note and got an audience with Lady Addee Ulphor at the Ashaba House. - Party tracked Tessar's trail through the fey-touched Living Wood along Old Skull's northern slope — skill challenge, 4 successes before 3 failures. Approached the drow cleft undetected; gained surprise.
- Fought and defeated Zeldrazz T'orrl (drow elite warrior), two drow scouts, and a giant spider in the cleft chamber beneath Old Skull's northern flank. Rescued Rellan Tessar (bound to a stalagmite, conscious, exhausted).
- Returned Tessar to Shadowdale. Lady Ulphor received them privately, paid the balance, accepted the map fragment and Vhaeraun mask pendant with composed dread, and extended her private goodwill. Warned them to keep it quiet; said Captain Helm would be "managed."
- That evening at the Old Skull Inn, Orvyn Tal — a bookseller — sat down uninvited and slid a Dalelands map across the table. Asked, mildly, whether they'd seen anything interesting on their walk. The Harpers are now on the board.

> The pines thin into a stand of black oaks whose roots clutch the granite like fingers. Beyond them, a fissure splits the northern flank of Old Skull — a slanted black wound in the rock, taller than a man, breathing out cold air that smells of wet stone and something older. > Vhaeraunian field officer. Iron half-mask, twin scimitars, expects to win.

- Party went directly to Lady Ulphor rather than approaching Corwick Helm — consistent with Torval's setup and her private instruction.
- Successfully achieved surprise in the skill challenge; the combat did not involve Tessar being used as a hostage.
- Party delivered the map fragment and the iron half-mask to Lady Ulphor rather than keeping them — she now holds the key intelligence items from the session.
- Interaction with Orvyn Tal: unclear yet how forthcoming the party was; outcome determines warmth of Harper relationship going forward.

> - The Vhaeraunian map fragment shows **two more staging sites** on Old Skull's northern flank. Lady Ulphor will want them scouted before the Vhaeraunians reinforce.
> - **Corwick Helm** filed Tessar's disappearance as desertion to avoid triggering a mobilization. Lady Ulphor said she would "manage" him — what that looks like is an open question.
> - **Orvyn Tal's offer** — the Harpers want to know if the Vhaeraunian incursion is coordinated with anyone on the surface. They will pay for answers.

- **Torval Dunmore** — first contact; vouched for the party, gave them Ulphor's note. Genuine concern for Tessar; now trusts the party.

- **Rellan Tessar** — rescued; dehydrated, three cracked ribs, grateful but not dramatic. DM ADDITION: add to [[roster]] as recurring NPC.
- **Orvyn Tal** — introduced at session end; tested the party's discretion. Harper faction is now in play.

### Combat & Encounters
- **Skill Challenge — The Living Wood:** Group tracking challenge, 4 successes before 3 failures. Party succeeded — approached undetected, gained surprise.
- **The Drow Cleft (Scene 4):** Zeldrazz T'orrl (CR 5 drow elite warrior) + 2 drow scouts (CR 1/4) + 1 giant spider (CR 1). Hard encounter for 5 × level 5. Party had surprise. All enemies defeated; Tessar recovered. Adjusted XP: ~4,200.

### Loot & Rewards
- **300 gp** from Lady Ulphor (150 gp advance + 150 gp on completion)
- **~125 gp** in camp goods (50 gp mixed coin from camp; Zeldrazz's scimitar worth ~75 gp to the right buyer — drow-made, ornate, non-magical)
- **~425 gp total** for the party
- **Vhaeraunian map fragment** (vellum, Undercommon script, three marked sites on Old Skull's northern flank) — delivered to Lady Ulphor
- **Zeldrazz's iron half-mask pendant** (Vhaeraun's sigil — worthless as treasure, priceless as intelligence) — delivered to Lady Ulphor
- **Milestone:** Advance PCs to halfway through level 5 (or ~1,500 XP per PC if tracking discretely)
- **Reputation:** Lady Ulphor's private favor. Torval's trust. Orvyn Tal's cautious interest.

> [!dm] DM Notes
> - Add **Rellan Tessar** to [[roster]] — he owes the party his life and should recur as a militia contact.
> - Track whether **Zeldrazz escaped** — if he was killed rather than retreating, remove from villain pool; if he fled down the cleft, he becomes a recurring antagonist who knows the party's faces.
> - The **two remaining cleft sites** from the map are the natural Session 2 thread. Lady Ulphor will be the one to ask — she has the map.
> - **Corwick Helm's cover-up** is unresolved. The party hasn't met him yet. Lady Ulphor's "management" of the situation is an open scene worth playing out.
> - Note for **Orvyn Tal** roleplay: his reaction to the party depends on how forthcoming they were. If guarded, he was equally pleased — but the relationship starts cooler. Confirm and track.

## Session 002 — The Hawthorn Chimney
**Date played:**
**Location in-world:** Shadowdale — Ashaba House, the Living Wood (southwestern flank of Old Skull), Site B (the Hawthorn Chimney)
**Players present:** Kaitlyn (Kto), Fox (Fiorn), Sev (Yinu), Lily (Loric T.), Piper (Nalith)

### What Happened
- Party recalled to Ashaba House. Lady Ulphor reported that the militia watchers she'd posted on the two remaining map sites had returned mixed news: the **Site B** pair had stopped reporting in the day before, and the **Site C** pair had been forced back by fey withdrawing a quarter-mile around the cleft.
- **Corwick Helm** arrived mid-briefing and pushed back — dismissed his missing men as "drinking by the river" and refused to commit until tomorrow. Fiorn was openly contemptuous (the now-canonical "eats another piece of corn" bit). Corwick stormed out warning he'd go himself if they weren't found.
- Yinu identified the corner sigil on the recovered Vhaeraunian map as a **drow priestly mark** (Religion 20). Confirmed a drow priestess is on the surface and that drider/driker escorts are a real possibility.
- **Brynn Ashford** pulled **Loric T.** aside privately and disclosed that **Orvyn Tal is a Harper**, that Brynn distrusts their motives, and asked the party to bring findings to him *before* the Harpers — with a vague offer of "incentivity." Loric was noncommittal. **Nalith eavesdropped from under a chair**, undetected; the rest of the party was looped in afterward.
- Party departed Shadowdale and traveled ~5 hours southwest through the Living Wood to **Site B (the Hawthorn Chimney)**. No militia escort taken.
- Found the camp recently abandoned: cold fire pit, three bedrolls (one heavily bloodstained), a half-burnt **bone scroll case** in the fireplace. Yinu hit a 28 Investigation lying under the chimney and spotted a hairy, bladed limb on the smoke shelf — yelled a warning, party gained surprise on initiative.
- Fought a wounded **drider (Lolthite enforcer)** and **two giant spiders** climbing up from below. Fiorn raged and reckless-attacked for repeated heavy hits (one for 22 finished a spider). Yinu's Firebolt for 17 exposed the drider's still-beating heart. Loric chipped in with Firebolts; one spider caught fire and burned over time. **Yinu finished the encounter with Fireball into the chimney shaft**, incinerating the last spider in the enclosed space (and catching herself in the blast).
- **Scroll recovered from the fireplace** read aloud: *"Close the surface mouths. The Vhaeraun is opening."* — signed in **Lolthite** script. Loric's Religion check (17+) confirmed the writers were **Lolthites**, distinct from the **Vhaeraunians** whose map the party recovered last session.
- Inspection of the cleft itself: the gap had been deliberately **collapsed**. Yinu's Arcana check confirmed **drow magic** was used to seal it. A Lolthite raiding party purged this Vhaeraunian camp the night before and shut the underdark connection here behind them. **Site C remains open and unscouted.** Session ended at the cleft, with the party preparing to travel to Site C.

> [!read-aloud] Approaching the Hawthorn Chimney
> The hawthorn closes overhead in a low arch — pale berries, black thorns. Beneath the boughs, a fire pit lies cold under a film of ash, three bedrolls splayed around it like petals torn from a flower. One has a long dark stain along its length. The chimney mouth is a dark wound in the rock, and from inside, very faintly, comes the sound of something dragging itself upward.

> [!boss] The Chimney Drider — Lolthite Enforcer
> Wounded survivor of last night's purge. Climbed up to silence the witnesses. Dropped before she could retreat down the shaft.

### Key Decisions & Consequences
- **Loric did not commit to Brynn's "first call" arrangement.** The Council/Harper wedge is now an active, unanswered thread.
- **Nalith's eavesdropping was clean** — Brynn doesn't know the rest of the party heard the exchange.
- **Public rift with Corwick Helm widened.** Fiorn's open contempt at the briefing has put the Captain on personal bad terms with the party.
- **Site B triaged, not exhausted.** No interrogation (drider killed); the collapsed shaft was not investigated further; no attempt to follow the Lolthite trail downward.
- **Two-faction drow war is now confirmed party knowledge** — Lolthites sealing surface anchors that Vhaeraunians are opening.

### NPC Interactions
- **Lady Addee Ulphor** — composed; touched the Pendant of Ashaba twice. Confirmed the priestess-sigil identification.
- **Corwick Helm** — combative; relationship with the party degraded after Fiorn's contempt at the briefing. Stormed out.
- **Brynn Ashford** — first significant on-stage appearance. Revealed Orvyn Tal's Harper affiliation. Pulled Loric aside, pitched the "first call" arrangement; Loric noncommittal.
- **Orvyn Tal** — off-stage. Now confirmed Harper to the party.

### Combat & Encounters
- **The Hawthorn Chimney:** wounded drider (CR 6) + 2 × giant spiders (CR 1). Party had surprise. All defeated. No PCs dropped. ~2,700 XP — Hard for 5 × level 5.

### Loot & Rewards
- **30 gp** in mixed coin (party pool now ~**630 gp** collective)
- **Broken ceremonial half-mask** (~80 gp; Orvyn Tal would pay more, Lady Ulphor less). Party kept it.
- **Half-burnt Lolthite scroll** ("Close the surface mouths…") — intelligence item, currently held by the party
- *(Adventure plan also lists drow poison × 2 vials at Site B — not explicitly recovered in play; confirm next session whether the bedrolls were searched.)*
- **Reputation:** Lady Ulphor — unchanged favor. Corwick Helm — degraded. Brynn Ashford — contact opened, unanswered. Harpers — not yet engaged.

> [!hook] Loose Ends & Hooks
> - **Site C remains open and unscouted** — the natural Session 003 thread.
> - **Brynn vs. Orvyn / Council vs. Harpers.** Loric owes Brynn an answer before reporting to Tal.
> - **The Lolthite faction** is now active under Old Skull and willing to purge surface camps; they don't know the party exists yet.
> - **Corwick Helm's relationship with the party** is now actively strained — Lady Ulphor's prior promise to "manage" him is more relevant.
> - **Drow priestess on the surface** — confirmed by sigil; not yet sighted. Almost certainly at Site C.
> - **Drider trail downward** — uninvestigated. The collapsed shaft prevents pursuit *here*, but the broader Lolthite incursion route is unknown.

> [!dm] DM Notes
> - **Aelinor Wains was not used.** No militia escort requested; the trailhead-reserve element from the adventure plan is unspent.
> - **Yinu took her own Fireball** in the chimney — track residual HP into Site C.
> - **Mark Brynn Ashford as a recurring on-stage NPC** — first major appearance, factional alignment exposed.
> - **Mark Zeldrazz T'orrl as "escaped"** in the villain pool (Session 001 fate now resolved by adventure-plan continuity — he's expected at Site C).
> - The **Lolthite vs. Vhaeraunian war** is the key new lore — surface confirmation, party-known.

## The Half-Mask Shrine — Session 003 Outline

**Tier 2 · 5 PCs at L5 → milestone to L6 · ~3.5–4 hours · Setting: Site B cleft → Old Skull's northern flank → the Shrine-Camp**

**Hook from S2:** Site B closed by Lolthite raid; Site C still open; drow priestess sigil confirmed; Loric still owes Brynn an answer.

### Scene 1 — Cold Camp at the Hawthorn Chimney *(short cold-open)*
- Dawn at the collapsed Site B cleft. Long rest taken. Yinu fully recovered.
- **Brynn beat:** Loric finds a sealed message-tube tucked in his pack from the night before. Brynn's letter is a polite reminder of the "first call" arrangement and three pointed questions. Loric chooses whether to draft a reply by raven now (Sela's cottage handles ravens), defer, or refuse.
- **Sela's poultice count, scroll, half-mask** — quick inventory beat so the table remembers what they're carrying.
- **Decision:** push for Site C now (~4 hours) or scout the perimeter first.

### Scene 2 — The Northern Traverse
- 4 hours overland skirting Old Skull's granite shoulder.
- **One light skill beat** (Survival/Nature DC 13) for the route. Failure = arrive at dusk, lose Watcher-spot advantage.
- **One scripted intercept option:** a Lolthite forward scout's track-sign on a stone shelf — DC 14 Survival to read direction and freshness. *This is the party's only forewarning that the Lolthites are also moving on Site C.* If they miss it, the Crash hits cold.

### Scene 3 — The Watcher Above
- Drow Scout (CR 1/2) in a wind-stunted pine, 60 ft. above the cleft mouth, brass signal horn at her belt.
- **DC 17 Perception** to spot her first. Horn = Khelziir's cell goes to alert; party loses surprise on the antechamber.
- Spider-silk tripwires across the cleft mouth (DC 14 Perception; DC 12 Sleight of Hand to cut clean). Side-chimney climb (DC 15 Athletics) drops them into Chamber 1 from the ceiling.

### Scene 4 — The Antechamber
- 30×30 ft. cavern. **2× Drow Scout** on watch (one fletching, one dozing). Cookfire, weapon rack, two bedrolls.
- If alerted, the dozing scout sprints for the Shrine to warn Khelziir; the other holds the choke at the spider-silk curtain.

### Scene 5 — The Spider Pen
- 20×40 ft. side chamber. **1× Giant Spider** chained to the wall as Vhaeraunian sentinel.
- Disturbing the silk curtain triggers a trained alarm shriek audible throughout the dungeon.
- Cutting the chain weaponizes it indiscriminately — viable if the party wants to bleed Khelziir's tactics.

### Scene 6 — The Shrine *(Boss)*
- 40×50 ft. chamber. Black basalt altar, half-mask banner, partial obsidian portal anchor 8 ft. across, half-inscribed in luminous silver.
- **Khelziir Aun'velve** (CR 6) at the altar mid-ritual. **Zeldrazz T'orrl** (CR 5, demoted, scarred) flanks him. Zeldrazz **opens with poisoned attacks on Kto** — she's the one who put him down in S1.
- **Ritual countdown: 2 rounds.** Each round Khelziir is alive, conscious, and not silenced ticks it down. Zero = portal opens, **+4× Vhaeraunian Drow** step through. Encounter shifts to Deadly.
- **Stopping the countdown:** kill or KO Khelziir, silence him for a full round (he can step out — costs him a round, not a victory), or destroy the half-anchor (AC 12, 40 HP, vulnerable to bludgeoning; striking it provokes OAs and Khelziir treats it as an attack on himself).

### Scene 7 — The Lolthite Crash *(pressure valve)*
- **Trigger:** the boss fight reaches initiative round 4, **or** the party stalled at the cleft mouth for any reason. **3× Lolthite Drow** burst into the antechamber and push toward the Shrine.
- Vhaeraunians prioritize them — they hate each other more than they hate the surface.
- **Party options:** hold the choke, slip past in the chaos with the anchor, or pick a side and watch the other side get shredded.
- **Lore consequence:** *the Lolthites now know the surface party exists.* Lolth's people are no longer a passive third pole.

### Scene 8 — Three Endings
- **(1) Smash the anchor.** Loud win. Public credit. Vhaeraunian retaliation incoming in 2–3 weeks.
- **(2) Steal the anchor** (DC 16 Arcana — Yinu or Loric). Quiet Harper win. Orvyn Tal pays well; Brynn finds out and is furious if Loric didn't loop him in first.
- **(3) Feed it as a listening glyph** (DC 18 Religion or Arcana, after Khelziir falls). **+500 gp** Harper bounty + recruitment offer. The Vhaeraunians don't know they're being heard. Yet.

### Scene 9 — Debrief at Ashaba House
- Lady Ulphor's working room. The political payoff happens here, not the dungeon.
- **Brynn vs. Orvyn beat.** Loric's answer (or his silence) lands publicly or privately, depending on Ending. If Ending 2 was taken without looping Brynn in, Brynn corners Loric privately at session end with a sharper second ask.
- **Corwick resolution.** Lady Ulphor reports she and Corwick spoke. He's offered a private apology, in person, to whichever PC he wronged most (likely Fiorn). He's still captain; Lady Ulphor has spent capital to keep him there and the party knows it.
- **Milestone → Level 6.**

### New NPC — **Quillip Burr-and-Whistle**, Curious Pixie of the Living Wood

- **Statline base:** Pixie *(MM p.253; CR 1/4)*. Tiny fey, neutral good. AC 15, HP 1, fly 30 ft. Innate spellcasting (CHA): at-will *druidcraft*; 1/day each — *confusion, dancing lights, detect evil and good, detect thoughts, dispel magic, entangle, fly, phantasmal force, polymorph, sleep*. Superior Invisibility. Magic Resistance.
- **Why she's here when the rest of the wood withdrew:** stubborn curiosity. A drow priest setting up shop in *her* granite shoulder is the most interesting thing that's happened in eighty years and she refused to leave. She has been **watching the Watcher** for two days from inside a hollow knothole, taking notes (which are pinecones arranged by importance).
- **Tone:** playful, archly polite, speaks in rhyming couplets when excited and trails off mid-sentence when bored. Calls the party "the loud ones" before learning their names and "the loud ones" after, too. Will be invisible until she chooses to be seen — which she'll do the moment a PC says or does anything that interests her (a song fragment, a true name spoken aloud, Nalith's Druidic, Fiorn's shapechange, etc.).

### What she offers (party picks one — she's not a vending machine)

- **Intelligence.** Headcount inside the cleft (2 scouts, 1 priest, 1 "the angry one with the new scar," 1 "the big bitey leg-thing in the silk room"), the alarm-shriek behavior of the spider, the fact that the priest "is mid-knot — if you cut him before he ties it, the knot unravels."
- **A diversion.** She'll lure the Watcher down out of the pine with a *phantasmal force* (a wounded fawn, a fallen comrade, etc.) — Watcher must save vs. DC 14 INT or descend, granting the party a clean kill or pass-through.
- **A single boon, banked.** She casts *polymorph* OR *confusion* OR *sleep* once, on a target the party names, at a moment they call for it (within 24 hours). She'll do it from invisibility, then vanish.

### What she asks in return (she names one — fey choose, mortals don't)

GM picks the bargain that fits whoever struck it. Suggested table:

| If the PC is… | She asks for… |
|---|---|
| Fiorn (Musician/Entertainer) | A song never sung in the Living Wood before — performed *now*, badly is fine, but it must be true to the singer |
| Nalith (Druid, speaks Druidic) | A name. Nalith's *true* name in Druidic — not the one she goes by — to be kept safe in a pinecone |
| Yinu (Wizard, scribe) | One page from the Awakened Spellbook, any spell, copied out *for her* in Yinu's own hand. Yinu does not lose the spell |
| Loric (Tiefling, Infernal) | A secret about himself he has never told another living person. She will know if he lies |
| Kto (Fighter, plain) | A promise. Specifically: that the next time Kto sees a wounded fawn in the Living Wood, she will not kill it. Binding. |
| The party as a group | A token from far away — Fiorn's Eberron-linked trinket would close the deal instantly, but a Waterdhavian coin or a Cormyrian pin works too |

All bargains are **honored fey-style** — the boon comes through reliably; the cost comes due *exactly as stated, no more, no less.* No monkey's-paw twists. (This is Quillip, not a hag.)

- She is a **clean recurring NPC option** — small, tidy, low-CR, easy to bring back. If the party stiffs her, she returns in a later session politely demanding payment with interest. If they treat her well, she becomes a casual fey contact in the Living Wood — useful for an Underdark-adjacent campaign.

### Refusal path

If the party brushes her off or threatens her, she vanishes cleanly (Superior Invisibility) and **does not** tip off the Vhaeraunians — that would be aiding drow, which she finds distasteful. But she also doesn't help, and the offered intel/diversion/boon is gone for this session. She will remember.
